generation.rendered_text:
Recorded policy scope

The recorded scope of "Key Safe Procedure" includes "Willow Bank Community Service". This is a statement of recorded policy applicability only; it does not establish what action is safe or required. The reason for this scope is not established by the scope record.

Other requested guidance

Current version (effective 1 April 2026) requires care staff to contact the on-call registered manager immediately after any fall and, where injury is suspected, also to contact the falls lead (the nurse or therapist designated at each site) immediately — the policy describes this as a mandatory dual-contact escalation for any fall with suspected injury and notes the falls lead provides clinical assessment alongside other escalation where needed.

Previous version (effective 1 March 2025) required care staff to contact the on-call registered manager immediately after any fall; it did not require contacting a falls lead for suspected-injury falls (falls lead contact was not part of the earlier escalation requirement).
